text: Harbour City's late tactical shift to press higher (press increased from 0.6 to 0.78) and play more direct (directness rose from 0.28 to 0.43) raised their possession from 31.7% to 40.8% in the final minutes [#1884]. This more aggressive approach departed from their usual patient short passing but failed to generate shots or significant chances, as Seabrook Town’s wide, crossing play exploited the space behind Harbour City's higher line [#1884]. Despite creating pressure, Harbour City struggled to convert possession into meaningful offensive opportunities, exposing a vulnerability in midfield coverage when pushing the line up [#1884]. For future coaching, emphasize maintaining a balanced midfield presence when increasing line height to avoid being stretched by wide attackers.
